MECENG C85.sentiment: Reviews are mixed. Many say the class is easy and the exams fair, with problems hinted ahead of time, while others find lectures hard to follow and feel they had to teach themselves. Homework is reasonable and counts for a good share of the grade. Several say it is an easy A but weak for learning the material.
